title: Relay App Workflow
description: A workflow definition in Relay.app, representing an automated process that can be triggered via webhooks, schedules, app events, or manual activation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow.

triggerType.description: The type of trigger that starts this workflow.

createdAt.description: Date and time the workflow was created.

updatedAt.description: Date and time the workflow was last updated.
